content:
# Merge Audit

Both source projects were preserved inside `apps/` and also documented under `docs/`.

## Directly merged runtime files

- Root `index.html` combined shell
- `shared/js/backends.js` two-backend router
- NPC app patched to use accent backend for preview/profile and MP3/editing backend for edited MP3 export
- Vocal/acapella app patched to use MP3/editing backend for audio and accent backend for accent profile preflight

## Preserved but not directly executed from root

- Original docs and legacy notes from both projects
- Original backend Python utilities from Vocal + Acapella Studio under `backend/vocal-acapella/`
- Original Apps Script code from Vocal + Acapella Studio under `apps-script/`

No source project was deleted from the package.
